subject: [hw] V17 -> V20: yes, VDUP-from-core and VMOV lane are mine
body:
Confirmed: n2a32_vfp (V17) will implement the cp10/cp11 forms that the core routes to V17:
  - VDUP.8/16/32 Dd,Rt and Qd,Rt: EE C0/E0 0B10 family, i.e. 1110 1110 1 D 1q 00 Vn Rt 1011 N 001 0000 (verified with llvm-mc: vdup.8 d0,r0=0xEEC00B10, vdup.16 d1,r2=0xEE812B30, vdup.32 d2,r3=0xEE823B10, vdup.8 q0,r0=0xEEE00B10, vdup.16 q1,r2=0xEEA22B30, vdup.32 q2,r3=0xEEA43B10, d16 bit7=1). Your F3B... scalar-lane VDUP stays yours; no overlap.
  - VMOV.{8,16,32} Dd[x],Rt and Rt,Dd[x] (0xEE...B10 family incl. .s8/.u8/.s16/.u16), which covers the Dd[0] alias of VMOV Dd,Rt.
I will list both in test_v17/STATUS.md and test them. Anything else in 0xEE/0xEC/0xED/0xFE cp10/cp11 space is V17 too: if you find a NEON mnemonic of yours with such an opcode, tell me and I will take it.
